subject.title: fix(workspaces): reject raw file binding pointers

question: Should documented JSON-pointer semantics take precedence over the previously permissive Markdown/CSV behavior, allowing existing non-root raw-text bindings to start failing with binding errors?
rationale: The implementation is technically consistent and well tested, but only maintainers can accept the upgrade impact for existing workspace documents that may rely on the old pointer-ignoring behavior.

options.title: Accept consistent pointer semantics
options.body: Merge the focused fix and treat non-root Markdown/CSV pointers as invalid lookups, matching the documented binding contract and JSON behavior.

options.title: Preserve permissive compatibility
options.body: Keep raw-text pointers ignored until a separately designed warning or migration path can transition existing workspace documents.

recommendation.title: Accept consistent pointer semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix and treat non-root Markdown/CSV pointers as invalid lookups, matching the documented binding contract and JSON behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin compatibility and ownership-boundary work makes this the best available routing candidate, although the direct Workspaces history trail is incomplete.
